title: Meet the 2028 Potential Presidential Contenders – Raphael Warnock
text:
2028 presidential race: Meet the contenders – Raphael Warnock | CNN 
 politics All candidates Raphael Warnock Meet the 2028 Potential Presidential Contenders 
 Published November 11, 2026
 Presidential campaigns aren’t built in a day, so while 2028 feels far off, and 2026 midterms are barely in the rearview mirror, it’s not too early to start tracking the field of potential candidates even if none have technically launched a campaign. 
 A large field of Democrats is expected to join the campaign, while Republicans will need to maneuver around President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance as they angle to inherit his MAGA coalition. 
 This list, which is intentionally broad, includes even some people who have said, repeatedly, that they will not run. It will be updated as news becomes available. 
 32 potential candidates
 18 Democrats 13 Republicans 1 Unk. Potential candidates
 Click to see each potential contender’s recent comments about running (or not running), latest news and other background information. Names are listed in alphabetical order.

 × Raphael Warnock 
 The pastor Raphael Warnock 
 US Senator from Georgia
 Age (at election) 59 Party Democrat Born Savannah, GA Warnock has won multiple times in Georgia, an important indicator of the power he could bring as a candidate. 
 The senior pastor at Martin Luther King Jr.’s former church in Atlanta, Warnock can talk about faith and righteousness in a way that many Democrats cannot. Warnock has talked about reclaiming faith from the religious right and specifically challenged the faith-based political appeals of Republicans like Vice President JD Vance and House Speaker Mike Johnson. 
 He could have a unique approach to reaching Black voters in neighboring South Carolina, the first Democratic primary state. Perhaps his biggest challenge is that many Democrats would rather see his Georgia colleague, Sen. Jon Ossoff, run instead.
